name: Wake & Actions
description: Wake-on-LAN from any lease, reservation, or device row, plus a favourites list for the hosts you wake often. Sends a standard magic packet (with optional SecureOn password) to both the subnet's directed broadcast and 255.255.255.255.
author: Matthew Thibodeau

db_migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wol_hosts (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, mac VARCHAR(17) NOT NULL UNIQUE, ip VARCHAR(15) NULL, subnet_id INT NULL, label VARCHAR(100), secureon VARCHAR(23) NULL, last_woken_at DATETIME NULL, last_woken_by VARCHAR(100) NULL)
